notes: All textures, 3D models, sprites and sounds are generated procedurally at load time (canvas / Three.js geometry / Web Audio offline rendering). No third-party art or audio files are bundled.
Drop licensed files into src/assets/audio/ using the exact names from the brief (e.g. creak-1.ogg, monster-howl.ogg) and list them here; they automatically override the synthesized versions.
